userInputText: FNF: Salty's Sunday Night - A mod with a humorous style and dramatic rap battles is waiting for you! Dance to the music and conquer the addictive tunes!FNF: Salty's Sunday Night will take you into gripping rap battles with Salty, a character who looks quite normal but possesses extremely impressive rapping skills. This mod stands out with unique music, an engaging storyline, and a detailed graphic style, creating a completely new experience for players.
